attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Veterinary Medicine (Secretary of State, Office of Professional Regulation)

rules.alternatives: Voluntary national credentialing (VTNE) follows its own rules, not state law.
rules.notes: Vermont does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. The veterinary practice act (26 V.S.A. ch. 44) licenses veterinarians only and does not mention technicians; § 2403(10) exempts a veterinarian's employees working under direct on-premises supervision. OPR's veterinary forms cover veterinarian applications only.
rules.rule_quote: (10) Any employee of a licensed veterinarian performing duties other than diagnosis, prescription, or surgery under the direct on-premises supervision of the veterinarian who is responsible for his or her performance.
